description: This file defines a React component for an Activity page that displays real-time activity logs in timeline or table view. It includes state management, WebSocket subscriptions, data fetching from an API, and rendering of activity items with styling and user interface controls.

methods.name: normalizeRealtime
methods.description: Converts incoming WebSocket payload into an ActivityItem object with timestamp, user, action, and details.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches activity data from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: getActionColor
methods.description: Determines the color style based on the action string.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a user name for avatar display.
